description: This file defines the MBField class, which models a field within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder framework. It includes properties for field attributes and methods for generating field definitions used in the CRM schema.

classes.name: MBField
classes.description: A class representing a configurable field within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, providing methods to generate vardef arrays for field metadata.

methods.name: getFieldVardef
methods.description: Generates a vardef array for the field, setting various properties based on the field's attributes.

methods.name: addDropDown
methods.description: Returns the options property, used for enum fields, as part of vardef.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Returns the label's variable name for the field.
